ns2:course.label: Seminar in Early Modern Literature
ns2:course.description: Seminar dedicated to the study of texts, genres, themes, and/or theoretical issues from the non-Shakespearean literature of the early modern period (approximately 1500-1700). May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 12 hours, if topics vary. Prerequisite: A college course devoted entirely to an aspect of Renaissance studies or consent of instructor.
